title: Spectral Gating via Damped Oscillations for Adaptive Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2606.23129v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Implicit Neural Representations (INRs) have been proven successful in encoding continuous signals through coordinate-based networks, yet facing a spectral dilemma: periodic activations capture fine details but act as all-pass filters that memorise noise, while spatially compact activations regularise effectively but suffer from low-frequency bias. Existing attempts to resolve this trade-off introduce computational overhead or tuning frailty. We propose to model each neuron's activation as the steady-state response of a sinusoidally-forced damped harmonic oscillator, whose amplitude naturally governs the network's spectral selectivity during training. By jointly optimising the oscillator parameters alongside the network weights, our method adapts to the target signal's spectral content without explicit regularisation. Initialised in the stopband, the network exhibits a coarse-to-fine learning curriculum that progressively expand

translated_title: 基于阻尼振荡频谱门控的自适应隐式神经表示
translated_abstract: 隐式神经表示（INRs）已被证明能够通过基于坐标的网络成功编码连续信号，但面临一个频谱困境：周期激活函数能够捕捉精细细节，却如同全通滤波器般记忆噪声；而空间紧凑的激活函数虽然能有效正则化，却存在低频偏差问题。现有解决这一权衡的方法要么引入额外计算开销，要么存在调参脆弱性。我们提出将每个神经元的激活建模为正弦强迫阻尼谐振子的稳态响应，其振幅在训练过程中自然地调控网络的频谱选择性。通过将振子参数与网络权重进行联合优化，我们的方法无需显式正则化即可自适应目标信号的频谱内容。网络在阻带中初始化后，展现出由粗到细的学习课程，逐步扩展……（摘要原文至此截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将神经元激活建模为正弦强迫阻尼谐振子的稳态响应，通过联合优化振子参数与网络权重实现自适应频谱门控，无需显式正则化即可解决隐式神经表示中细节捕捉与噪声抑制之间的频谱权衡问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes modeling each neuron's activation as the steady-state response of a sinusoidally-forced damped harmonic oscillator, jointly optimizing oscillator parameters with network weights to achieve adaptive spectral gating that resolves the detail-versus-noise trade-off in implicit neural representations without explicit regularization.
